df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

    'loyal_in_data': 'loyal' in df['customer_segment'].unique(),
    'segment_values': list(df['customer_segment'].unique()),
    'status_completed': 'completed' in df['status'].unique(),
    'has_999999_99': (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 6,
    'revenue_is_string': df['revenue'].dtype == 'object',
    'refunded_included': (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum() > 0
}

premises"}
